title: (RHSA-2025:1078) Important: Red Hat Build of Apache Camel 4.8.3 for Spring Boot security update.
portal_summary:
Red Hat build of Apache Camel 4.8.3 for Spring Boot release and security update is now available.

Red Hat Product Security has rated this update as having a security impact of Important. A Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) base score, which gives a detailed severity rating, is available for each vulnerability from the CVE link(s) in the References section.
portal_synopsis: Important: Red Hat Build of Apache Camel 4.8.3 for Spring Boot security update.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Integration - Camel for Spring Boot|Red Hat Integration - Camel for Spring Boot|1|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
Red Hat build of Apache Camel 4.8.3 for Spring Boot release and security update is now available.

The purpose of this text-only errata is to inform you about the security issues fixed.

Security Fix(es):

* org.asynchttpclient/async-http-client: AsyncHttpClient (AHC) library's `CookieStore` replaces explicitly defined `Cookie`s (CVE-2024-53990)

* ch.qos.logback/logback-core: arbitrary code execution via JaninoEventEvaluator (CVE-2024-12798)

* org.apache.mina/mina-core: Apache MINA: applications using unbounded deserialization may allow RCE (CVE-2024-52046)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
